title: Rectangular base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Begin by drawing the first loop, which consists of four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0562, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.0562, 0.0) and ends at (0.0562, 0.0562); the third line starts at (0.0562, 0.0562) and ends at (0.0, 0.0562); and the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0562) and returns to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scale factor of 0.0562 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and translating it with a vector set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional model with a depth of 0.75 units. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Finally, define a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the rectangular base will be 0.05625 units in length, 0.05625 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.box(0.0562, 0.0562, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# The final model is represented as 'r'
